auth.passwordSubtitle: Sign in with email and password when your inbox is out of reach.

error.wrongPassword: Email address or password does not match.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
error.emailNotConfirmed: This address is not confirmed yet. Open the link in your inbox first.

onboarding.choosePath: How would you like to start?
onboarding.hasInviteHint: Invitation link or QR code from your club
onboarding.joinClubHint: Send a request – the board approves it
onboarding.clubKindQuestion: What kind of club are you?

onboarding.clubNameHint: The name everyone knows you by.
onboarding.seasonStartQuestion: When does your club year start?
onboarding.seasonStartHint: Point totals and leaderboards follow this date.
onboarding.seasonStartFootnote: The suggestion matches your kind of club and can be changed any time.
onboarding.clubSlugHint: The club tells you its short name. There is deliberately no directory of clubs.
onboarding.clubFoundHint: Is that the one? Then you can send your request.
onboarding.clubNotFound: No club with that short name. Ask the club for the exact spelling.
onboarding.requestPendingHint: You will get a message as soon as the board has decided.
onboarding.withdrawConfirm: The request will be withdrawn. You can send a new one at any time.

menu.administrationHint: Functions for the board and coaches to manage the club. Other members do not see this section.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.streak: {{count}} weeks of training in a row
dashboard.nextPointsHint: Concrete contributions open right now – and a fit for you.
dashboard.upcomingHint: Your teams and everything that concerns the whole club. The agenda shows the full calendar.
dashboard.nothingOpen: Nothing is open right now. That is fine too.
dashboard.welcomeHint: No bookings yet. The first contribution is right below.
dashboard.seasonTrendHint: Points per month since the season started.
dashboard.seasonTrendDescription: Points per month over {{count}} months, {{points}} points in total this season
dashboard.streakHint: {{count}} more weeks until the next streak bonus.

marketplace.title: Tasks
marketplace.subtitle: Tasks your club needs help with
marketplace.urgentHint: These deadlines fall within the next two days.
marketplace.draftsHint: A draft is invisible to members and notifies nobody. Tap to edit, swipe left to publish.
marketplace.expiredHint: Nobody took these on. They are no longer visible to members.

leaderboard.title: Rankings
leaderboard.optOutNotice: You do not appear in the ranking. You can change this in your profile.
leaderboard.empty: No points in this season yet
leaderboard.filterHint: Shorter periods also show who has just joined.
leaderboard.teamsHint: The average per member, so a large team is not ahead just because of its size. Teams with fewer than two visible members are not shown.
leaderboard.teamsEmpty: No team with points in this period yet
leaderboard.sourceHint: Nothing selected means every point counts. The groups are the five dimensions from «My strengths».
leaderboard.emptyFiltered: No points from «{{name}}» in this period yet

agenda.title: Agenda
agenda.declineReasonHint: The reason helps the organisers plan. It stays with the event and is not analysed.
agenda.declineEarly: You are cancelling in good time – that counts towards your reliability.
agenda.declineLate: The event starts soon. Declining never costs points.
agenda.declinedWithPoints: Decline saved – {{points}} points for cancelling in good time

filter.title: Filter
filter.typesHint: With nothing selected, the agenda shows all event types.
filter.teamsHint: Club events without a team are always included.

agenda.calendarFailed: The calendar entry could not be created.

profile.title: Profile
profile.spiderHint: Your view of yourself – only you see this analysis.
profile.deleteAccountHint: Permanently deletes your account and personal data.
profile.passwordHint: At least {{min}} characters. You can then sign in without a link.
profile.displayNameHint: This is how you appear in this club’s lists and leaderboards.
profile.contactHint: What you hide is not delivered to other members at all – not merely hidden. These choices apply per club.
profile.kudosHint: What the committee wrote about your contributions.
profile.addressHint: Only you and the board see the address, for mail and invoices.
profile.emergencyHint: Seen only by you, the board and the coaches of your teams, in case something happens on match day.

problem.countryCode: The country is two letters, for example CH or DE.

clubSettings.title: Club settings
clubSettings.adminOnly: Only the committee can edit the club.
clubSettings.name: Club name
clubSettings.seasonStartHint: Decides which season the points count towards. Currently: {{season}}. Without a date the calendar year applies.
clubSettings.themeHint: Takes effect immediately, without a new app version. Reset falls back to the standard colour.
clubSettings.labelsHint: What do you call your events? Empty means: standard wording.
clubSettings.logoHint: An address for now: file upload needs a storage this project has not set up yet.
clubSettings.contrastWarning: {{color}} has too little contrast with the text placed on it.
clubSettings.seasonChangeHint: Future entries will belong to the new season. Points already awarded keep theirs.
clubSettings.modulesHint: You need to switch nothing on. The app suggests a module when your club reaches a size where it carries.

voice.title: Voice
voice.body: Say a note – to a person, to a role, or anonymously to the board.

meeting.title: Meetings & offices
meeting.body: Proposals to the committee, documented answers, offices as a distribution list.

checkin.title: How you are
checkin.body: A short question after an event. Voluntary, private, no points.

pulse.title: Club pulse
pulse.body: The weekly recap: what is happening, what you are working on, where to join in.

health.title: Club health
health.body: Care signals for coaches and the board.

invoice.title: Invoices
invoice.body: Invoice state in the app and points for paying on time. They are still issued by the invoicing service.

goal.title: Season goal
goal.body: A goal in points per member and season, with progress and an overview for the board.

clubSettings.dnaHint: What you stand for. It is stored today; it will be used once there are writing-support functions.
clubSettings.leaderboardHint: Without a value the leaderboard shows the first 20; your own row always comes along.
clubSettings.hidePointsHint: The order stays, the number goes. Your own points remain on the home screen.
clubSettings.goalHint: How many points from volunteering and the marketplace each member should gather per season. Leaving it empty means no goal.
clubSettings.goalHintWithSuggestion: How many points from volunteering and the marketplace each member should gather per season. {{shifts}} shifts add up to {{points}} points. Leaving it empty means no goal.
clubSettings.logoUrlHint: Or enter the address of a logo that already lives on your website.

health.title: Club health
health.listHint: A signal is a reason to talk, not an assessment. Resolved ones disappear without a trace.
health.promptsHint: Adapt them and say it in your own words – these are suggestions, not scripts.
health.actionHint: The signal is about the club, not about a person.
health.alreadyTaken: Someone else is already taking care of it.
health.tookOver: Noted – the other people responsible can see it.
health.resolved: Done. The signal is gone, without a trace.
health.resolveHint: Resolved signals are deleted. No record is kept.

no_response.title: No reply yet
no_response.body: No response to the last {{detail}} events. Maybe the timing does not fit right now.
no_response.prompt1: Ask openly how things are going – without mentioning the events.
no_response.prompt2: Say you would be glad to see them again.
no_response.prompt3: Ask whether the times still work at all.
no_response.definition: Appears when no reply came for the last three events in your area.

silent_churn.title: Has not been around for a while
silent_churn.body: No participation for about {{detail}} days. A call says more than a message.
silent_churn.prompt1: Call instead of writing – and ask how they are.
silent_churn.prompt2: Tell them what is going on in the team.
silent_churn.prompt3: Ask what would have to change for it to work again.
silent_churn.definition: Appears after about 60 days without taking part in an event.

attendance_drop.title: Around less often than before
attendance_drop.body: Recently {{detail}} events attended – noticeably more before that.
attendance_drop.prompt1: Ask whether something has changed in daily life.
attendance_drop.prompt2: Ask whether the time or the place still works.
attendance_drop.prompt3: Say that the team misses them.
attendance_drop.definition: Appears if you were around noticeably less in the last 60 days than in the 60 before that.

comms_pause.title: No connecting message for {{detail}} days
comms_pause.body: The club last told a story without asking for anything {{detail}} days ago.
comms_pause.prompt1: What went well in recent weeks that nobody knows about?
comms_pause.prompt2: Who contributed something worth thanking publicly?
comms_pause.prompt3: What is coming up that the club can look forward to?
comms_pause.definition: About the club: for more than four weeks no message went out that was not a request.

connection_ratio.title: More asking than telling
connection_ratio.body: Over the last eight weeks {{detail}} – connecting messages to calls.
connection_ratio.prompt1: What can we tell before we ask for help again?
connection_ratio.prompt2: Which recent contribution deserves a thank you?
connection_ratio.prompt3: Would a club pulse be due now?
connection_ratio.definition: About the club: over eight weeks noticeably more asking than telling.

unknown.title: A signal
unknown.body: There is no description for this signal yet.
unknown.definition: There is no explanation for this signal yet.

succession_gap.title: Offices without a successor
succession_gap.body: {{detail}} offices are vacant or have been held by the same person for years.
succession_gap.prompt1: Ask at the next meeting who would feel up to taking it on.
succession_gap.prompt2: Ask the current holder what they would need to train someone.
succession_gap.prompt3: Write down what the office actually takes – it is often less than everyone assumes.
succession_gap.definition: Concerns the club: an office is vacant or has been held by the same person for more than three years.

contribution_gap.title: Members without a contribution
contribution_gap.body: {{detail}} members have not contributed yet this season, and the season is drawing to a close.
contribution_gap.prompt1: Do you know what they would need in order to join in?
contribution_gap.prompt2: Have you recently explained what these shifts are for?
contribution_gap.prompt3: Are there contributions that match their strengths that nobody has offered them?
contribution_gap.definition: Concerns the club: in the last eight weeks of a season, members with a goal have not contributed yet.

health.clubHint: Active means: a turnout, a reply or an entry in the last {{days}} days. Declining counts too – someone who declines is there.
health.teamsHint: Over the last ninety days. Small teams are not listed: there, a rate would be a statement about one person.
health.responsibilityHint: Counted are helper shifts and tasks this season. Who carries them is not shown – that is none of the number’s business.
health.responsibilityTight: Four fifths of the work rests on few shoulders. That is no reproach to the others, but a question about how we ask.
health.successionHint: Offices that need lead time. Tap one to open it in the list of offices.
health.definitionsHint: Every number on this page follows from these definitions. The club can change them.

definition.activeDays: Active means having left a trace within {{value}} days.
definition.silentDays: After {{value}} days without turning up, a signal appears.
definition.noResponseEvents: After {{value}} events without a reply, a signal appears.
definition.attendanceDropFrom: “Often there before” means a turnout above {{value}}.
definition.attendanceDropTo: A drop means a turnout below {{value}}.
definition.longTenureYears: An office counts as long held after {{value}} years.
definition.minGroup: Below {{value}} people no group figure is shown.

health.successHint: Two success definitions of the platform: newcomers with three turnouts in their first 90 days – and departures that appeared as a signal before. Counted, never listed.
health.routingHint: Without a selection the standard rule applies: coaches for their team and the board. Visibility is unaffected – this is only about the notification.
health.symmetryHint: The same yardsticks as for members: response time on proposals, open signals, vacant offices. A signal, not a verdict.
health.symmetryDetail: {{answered}} proposals answered, {{open}} open · {{signals}} signals open · {{vacancies}} offices vacant, on average for {{days}} days

firstSteps.title: First steps for {{club}}
firstSteps.footnote: That is all it takes – everything else can wait.

event.title: Create the first event
event.hint: So everyone knows when things happen

invite.title: Invite members
invite.hint: Share a link or QR code

news.title: Bring in news from your website

invite.title: Invitations
invite.listFootnote: Swipe left to revoke an invitation.
invite.scopeHint: A team invitation assigns the person to that team right away.
invite.adminWarning: Invited people receive full club rights and can change anything.
invite.limitsHint: Left empty, the invitation can be redeemed without limit.
invite.revokeConfirm: The invitation can no longer be redeemed. Members who already joined stay.
invite.shareHint: Anyone who opens the link becomes a member without further approval.
invite.qrFailed: The QR code could not be generated.
invite.displayNameHint: This is how you appear in lists and leaderboards.
invite.alreadyMember: You already belong to this club. Your role stays unchanged.
invite.invalidHint: Ask the club for a new invitation or send a join request.

invalid.exhausted: This invitation has already been fully used.

joinRequest.title: Join requests
joinRequest.decideHint: Without a different choice the person becomes a member.
joinRequest.rejectHint: The person gets a neutral message. No reason is stored.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: If you delete your account, your personal details disappear from every club you belong to. This cannot be undone.

removed.profile: Your display name and profile picture
removed.contact: Your contact details and sign-in account
removed.private: Your private notes and check-in answers

kept.points: Your point entries – with no link to you

deleteAccount.keptFootnote: They still count towards club statistics but carry no name. That way no past season’s leaderboard changes.
deleteAccount.blockedHint: In these clubs you are the only person with board rights. Appoint someone else first – or delete the club.
deleteAccount.confirmHint: We ask explicitly: type {{word}} in the field, because this cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.irreversible: You will be signed out afterwards.

members.title: Members
members.listFootnote: Tap a member to change role, status and teams.
members.teamsHint: A member can belong to several teams at once.
members.noTeams: The club has no teams yet
members.lastAdminHint: This person is the only board member. Appoint someone else before changing their role or status.
members.areaPlaceholder: e.g. Juniors – empty means all teams

pointRules.title: Point rules
pointRules.label: Label
pointRules.codeHint: The code identifies the rule technically. It is unique per club and cannot be changed later.
pointRules.codeTaken: That code already exists in your club.
pointRules.thanksOnlyHint: A value of zero means “thanks only”: the contribution is acknowledged but shown without a number. A rule that is switched off produces nothing at all.
pointRules.forwardHint: Changes apply to new entries from now on. Points already awarded stay as they are.
pointRules.limitHint: Left empty the rule counts without limit. The limit is checked on the server.
pointRules.deleteConfirm: “{{label}}” will be deleted. A rule with bookings or events stays – you will be told what still hangs on it.

eventForm.title: Create event
eventForm.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
eventForm.why: What is it for? Who does it help?
eventForm.whyHint: A call to action carries its purpose. Without it, it cannot be published.
eventForm.scopeHintTeam: As a coach you publish events for your teams. Club-wide events are created by the board.
eventForm.scopeHint: A team event appears only in that team’s agenda.
eventForm.ruleHint: The value of attending follows from this rule, not from an entry at check-in.
eventForm.seriesHint: A series creates all events at once and links them together.
eventForm.previewCapped: A series creates at most {{max}} events. Choose an earlier end date.
eventForm.capacityHint: Optional. With a number here, the agenda shows how many replies are still missing.

helperEvent.title: Publish a call for helpers
helperEvent.shiftsHint: Swipe left to remove a shift.
helperEvent.pointsHint: The suggestion follows the duration – half a day counts differently from a whole one. You can override it.
helperEvent.needsShift: A call for helpers needs at least one shift.
helperEvent.draftHint: A draft is invisible to members and notifies nobody.
helperEvent.mutedHint: Published – but without a push. No connecting message has gone out for over four weeks. Send a club pulse first.
helperEvent.needsWhy: Every call needs to say what it is for — otherwise it cannot be published.

newsImport.title: News from your website
newsImport.adminOnly: Only the board can connect the website.
newsImport.urlHint: This needs a website running WordPress – we pull the posts through its API. The check tells you whether yours has one. «ourclub.ch» is enough.
newsImport.checkFailedHint: Either the website does not run on WordPress, or its API is blocked. When in doubt, ask whoever looks after your website.
newsImport.categoriesHint: Without a selection, posts from all categories are imported. The API returns no more than 100 posts per sync.
newsImport.categoriesUnknown: Check the website and its categories will show up here. Without a selection, posts from all categories are imported.
newsImport.disconnectConfirm: New posts from the website will no longer appear in the feed. Imported news stays.
newsImport.scheduleHint: The sync then runs automatically every night. Changes to scope and categories are saved with «Refresh now».

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.taken: You are signed up – points follow once the organisers confirm the shift.
shifts.released: Signed off. The spot is free again.
shifts.declined: Declined. You can still take the shift later.
shifts.releasedWarned: Signed off. The organisers were told, because the shift is now short-staffed at short notice.
shifts.pointsHint: Each shift carries its own point value. It is credited once the organisers confirm the shift.
shifts.overlapMessage: You are already signed up for another shift at the same time. Take it anyway?
shifts.marketplaceHint: Events that still have places open. Tap one to take a shift.
shifts.marketplaceMoreHint: All helper shifts in the agenda – including the more distant ones and those already full.

roster.title: Confirm shifts
roster.empty: Nobody is signed up for this shift
roster.hint: Confirm the people who actually turned up. The shift's points are credited as you do.
roster.alreadyAwarded: Already confirmed; nothing is credited a second time.
roster.addHint: For stand-ins: signed up and confirmed in one step.
roster.addMessage: Who helped without being signed up? The person is signed up and confirmed in the same step.
roster.confirmedNoPoints: {{name}} confirmed – this shift awards no points.

checkIn.qrHint: Hold up the code so the people present can scan it. It is valid from 30 minutes before the start until the event ends.
checkIn.rosterEmpty: Nobody is expected at this event
checkIn.rosterHint: For anyone who cannot scan: record them here by hand.
checkIn.unmarked: The attendance mark is withdrawn. Points already credited stay.
checkIn.already: You were already checked in here. Nothing is credited twice.
checkIn.queued: No connection – your check-in is saved and will be sent once you are back online.

error.window: The code is only valid from 30 minutes before the start until the event ends.
error.wrongCode: This code belongs to a different event.
error.notMember: You are not a member of this club.
error.offline: No connection. Try again once you are back online.
error.generic: The check-in did not work. Please try again.
error.forbidden: You do not have permission for that.
error.camera: The camera cannot be opened. Check the camera permission for myclub.

checkIn.queueRejected_one: A saved check-in could no longer be booked – the window had closed.
checkIn.queueRejected_other: {{count}} saved check-ins could no longer be booked – the window had closed.

reminder.title: Remind those who haven't answered
reminder.confirm_one: One person has not answered yet. They will get a reminder with a way to answer straight away.
reminder.confirm_other: {{count}} people have not answered yet. They will get a reminder with a way to answer straight away.
reminder.tooSoon: A reminder for this event was already sent on {{when}}. At most once a day.
reminder.noneLeft: Nobody is left to remind – everyone has answered.

inbox.title: Messages
inbox.hint: Every notification is listed here – even without push. Tapping opens the item and marks it as read.
inbox.gone: This entry is no longer there.

taskForm.title: Post a task
taskForm.notDraftAnymore: This draft has since been posted and can no longer be changed.
taskForm.whyTitle: What is it for? Who does it help?
taskForm.whyHint: Without a reason, a task cannot be posted.
taskForm.pointsHint: The task carries its own value. 0 points means: thanks, not points.
taskForm.scopeHintTeam: As a coach you publish tasks for your teams. Club-wide tasks are created by the board.
taskForm.scopeHint: Without a team every member sees the task.
taskForm.recurringHint: A recurring task is posted again after each completed round.
taskForm.draftHint: A draft is invisible to members and notifies nobody.
taskForm.publishedMuted: Posted – but without a push. No connecting message has gone to the club for over four weeks. Send a club pulse first.

problem.whyMissing: Every task says what it is for – otherwise it cannot be posted.
problem.pointsNegative: The point value cannot be negative.
problem.assigneesTooLow: At least one person must be able to take the task on.
problem.dueInPast: The deadline is in the past.
problem.recurrenceOutOfRange: The rhythm lies between one day and two years.

taskForm.deleteDraftConfirm: “{{title}}” will be deleted. Members never saw this draft.

taskDetail.reported: Reported – the points follow with the confirmation.
taskDetail.proofHint: Optional. A link to a photo, a document or a confirmation.
taskDetail.proofInvalid: That is not a complete link. It starts with http:// or https://.
taskDetail.lateHint: The deadline has passed. You can still report it – you helped after all.
taskDetail.full: This task has already been taken.
taskDetail.awaiting: Reported. The committee will confirm it.
taskDetail.releaseHint: No point deduction and no record. The task goes back on offer.
taskDetail.released: Handed back. The task is open again.
taskDetail.releasedWarned: Handed back. The committee knows, because the deadline is close.

taskConfirm.waitingHint: Whoever did a task is waiting for a word – not a number.
taskConfirm.hint: The proof is shown as text. Only open it if you trust the source.
taskConfirm.nobody: Nobody has taken this task on yet
taskConfirm.thanksHint: One sentence is enough. It counts for more than the points.
taskConfirm.kudosReminder: A word of thanks does more than the number. You can confirm without one.
taskConfirm.confirmed: Confirmed. Your thanks is on its way.
taskConfirm.confirmedWithPoints_one: Confirmed. Your thanks is on its way, plus {{count}} point.
taskConfirm.confirmedWithPoints_other: Confirmed. Your thanks is on its way, plus {{count}} points.
taskConfirm.noteRequired: Sending something back goes with a note on what is missing.
taskConfirm.sentBack: Sent back. The person knows what is missing.
taskConfirm.notYourOwn: Someone else confirms your own contribution.

pointHistory.title: Points history
pointHistory.moreBelow: More bookings load as you scroll. The sum appears once all are loaded.

bookPoints.title: Book points
bookPoints.whoHint: Several people receive the same value and the same note.
bookPoints.pointsHint: A deduction does not start here, but as a correction of an existing booking.
bookPoints.noteHint: Without a reason, a year from now there is a number nobody can explain.
bookPoints.ledgerHint: Bookings are never changed or deleted. A correction is an additional counter-booking.
bookPoints.corrected: Balanced out. The original booking stays.

problem.noteMissing: Every manual booking states its reason.
problem.pointsNotPositive: The value is greater than zero. A deduction only happens as a correction.
problem.tooManyMembers: At most 100 people at a time.
problem.reasonMissing: A correction goes with its justification.

transparency.title: What does my club see?
transparency.collectedHint: These three sources only. None of them is an assessment of you as a person.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.body: Whether you were there at an event.

response.title: Replies
response.body: Whether you replied to an event.

invoice.title: Payment status
invoice.body: Whether an invoice is open. Not in service yet.

transparency.notCollectedHint: This is not a given, it is a commitment.

notData.usage: When and how often you open the app.
notData.readReceipts: Whether you have read a message.
notData.content: What you write or look at.

transparency.signalsHint: Complete – nothing is left out here. Signals expire by themselves and never become a record.
transparency.noSignals: There is currently no signal about you.
transparency.expiresHint: After that the signal is deleted, without a trace.
transparency.optOutHint: You still count anonymously towards team and club figures, and your points are untouched.
transparency.optedOut_one: Turned off. {{count}} existing signal was deleted.
transparency.optedOut_other: Turned off. {{count}} existing signals were deleted.
transparency.optedIn: Turned back on. Nothing appears retroactively.

dimensions.title: My strengths
dimensions.leadTitle: Strengths as a basis for talking
dimensions.chartDescription: Radar chart of the five value dimensions with comparison lines for team and club.
dimensions.legend: Area: you. Dashed: your team. Finely dotted: the club. There is no overall grade and no rank.
dimensions.tooEarly: The picture fills up with your first contributions.
dimensions.noComparison: The group is too small for a comparison

engagement.title: Engagement
engagement.grow: Being there – and replying to events so the planning holds.

volunteering.title: Volunteering
volunteering.source: From volunteer work and the marketplace.
volunteering.grow: Take a shift or a task from the marketplace.

finance.title: Finance
finance.source: From paying your invoices on time.
finance.grow: Settle invoices before the due date.

network.title: Network
network.source: From club life – everything that holds the club together.
network.grow: Join the occasions that are not the sport.

loyalty.title: Loyalty
loyalty.grow: Stay with it – and say yes to what you will keep.

dimensions.leadHint: Shows the same five dimensions the member sees – no rank, no export.

newsForm.title: Write news
newsForm.imageHint: As a link. There is no club storage for uploads yet.
newsForm.scopeHintTeam: As a coach you write news for your teams. Club-wide news is written by the board.
newsForm.scopeHint: Team news reaches that team only.
newsForm.published: Published. Everyone concerned has it in their inbox.
newsForm.editHint: Saving does not notify anyone again.
newsForm.retracted: Retracted. The inbox entry stays as history.
newsForm.retractConfirm: “{{title}}” will be removed for everyone. This cannot be undone.

problem.imageNotALink: That is not a complete link. It starts with http:// or https://.

pulse.title: Club pulse
pulse.ratioHint: Connecting messages and calls over the last eight weeks.
pulse.ratioTilted: For weeks the asking has outweighed the telling. A pulse brings that back into balance.
pulse.noDraft: There is no draft this week.
pulse.introHint: Optional. The pulse goes out without one – that is what it is prepared for.
pulse.allStruck: Nothing is left. Remove fewer items or discard the pulse.
pulse.released_one: Sent. {{count}} person has it in their inbox.
pulse.released_other: Sent. {{count}} people have it in their inbox.
pulse.discardHint: The draft expires. The connection ratio keeps running – that is an answer too.
pulse.discarded: Discarded. No pulse goes out this week.
pulse.gone: This pulse is no longer available.
pulse.pointsHint: Deliberately last: the pulse is about the club.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.inboxAlways: Every notification lands in the inbox.
notifications.inboxWhy: It cannot be turned off: it is the channel that reaches everyone, even without push.
notifications.pushPending: Push itself is not in service yet. Your choice applies already and will be honoured when sending starts.
notifications.emailHint: Cancellations, the membership decision and the club pulse always arrive immediately. Care signals and the check-in question never go by email. The email goes to your sign-in address.
notifications.emailOff: No email goes out. The inbox still holds everything.
notifications.quietHint: Nothing is delivered in this window, it is caught up afterwards. The inbox keeps filling.
notifications.quietInvalid: Start and end must be set and different.
notifications.saved: Saved. Applies from the next delivery.
notifications.devicesHint: Devices will appear here once push is in service.
notifications.securityNote: Sign-in links and account deletion notices always go by e-mail and are untouched by these settings.

input.title: Proposals and notes
input.body: When a note or proposal reaches you or gets an answer.

checkin.title: How you are
checkin.body: The short question after an event and the nudge meant only for you.

system.title: Connections
system.body: Technical notices, such as when the federation link falters.

notifications.deviceRegistered: Registered. Push will reach you once sending is running.

pushState.unsupported: This device does not know push notifications. The inbox still holds everything.
pushState.notConfigured: Push is not set up in this installation yet. The inbox holds everything.
pushState.denied: Push is blocked for this app. You can change that in the system settings – the inbox still holds everything.

voice.title: Voice
voice.micPending: Recording is still missing: transcription in the browser would send the audio to a third-party service, and that is ruled out. Until then you write.
voice.listHint: What is private is visible to you alone – not even to the committee.

kindHint.self_reflection: Stays strictly with you. Nobody else can read it.
kindHint.coach_log: Your log. Stays strictly with you.
kindHint.feedback: Goes to the chosen place – and only there.
kindHint.anonymous: Without any detail about you. Even the time is coarsened to the week.

voice.textLabel: What would you like to say?
voice.textHint: What stands here goes out as it is – nothing is sent unseen.
voice.anonymousHint: Your ticket for the reply is stored on this device. Clear the storage and the way back is gone – anything else would not be anonymity.

problem.quotaSpent: This month’s quota is used up.

voice.inboxHint: Notes addressed to you. Every one gets an answer – you may decline it, but not let it fade away.
voice.anonThreadHint: This thread hangs on the ticket on this device, not on your account. Nobody can trace it back to you.

done.flagged: Reported. The note has left your inbox.

voice.flaggedHint: A reported note leaves the inbox but is not deleted. Whoever reports does not decide alone.
voice.ticketLost: Your ticket could not be kept – the answer to this note will not reach you.

meeting.title: Meetings & inputs
meeting.empty: No proposal and no meeting yet.
meeting.bodyHint: What stands here is read by the chosen committee – and by nobody else.
meeting.sourceHint: Only your own notes: what others said does not belong in a committee.
meeting.committeeHint: A committee is a set of offices. When an office changes hands, the distribution list follows by itself.
meeting.personalHint: Your name stands on the proposal; you see its state at any time.
meeting.anonymousHint: Without any trace of you. State and answer sit behind a ticket on this device.
meeting.noOffices: This club has no offices yet. The board creates them under «Offices».
meeting.sentAnonymous: Submitted anonymously. You pick up the state here.
meeting.ticketLost: Your ticket could not be kept – you will no longer reach the state of this proposal.
meeting.inboxHint: Proposals addressed to an office you hold. Each one gets a state – and that alone is an answer.
meeting.mineHint: The state tells you what becomes of it.
meeting.meetingsHint: Tap a meeting for its collected view.
meeting.anonymousTrackHint: This case hangs on the ticket on this device, not on your account.
meeting.triageHint: Handle as you go, or schedule it for a meeting. Both reach the author right away.
meeting.answerHint: Two or three sentences. No closing without an answer – a refusal needs its reason too.
meeting.forwardHint: The case stays the same; only the recipients change. The previous scheduling no longer holds.
meeting.agendaEmpty: Nothing to handle – no proposal, no vacant office, no open shift.
meeting.agendaHint: The app goes no further for a meeting: no agenda items, no minutes.
meeting.agendaVacanciesHint: One of the two standing topics of every meeting.
meeting.publishHint: What gets published is the decision, not the proposal that was submitted. It appears in the feed and in every member’s inbox – and in the next club pulse.

offices.title: Offices
offices.hint: An office is a distribution list: a proposal goes to the office, not to the person. When they change, the list follows by itself.
offices.empty: No office yet. Without offices there is no committee a proposal could go to.
offices.vacantHint: Vacant offices are a standing topic of every meeting.
offices.titleHint: Chair, treasurer, secretary… A co-chair is two offices of the same name.
offices.removeConfirm: «{{title}}» will be dissolved. Proposals addressed to it remain, but reach nobody any more.
offices.marketplaceHint: Vacant means: nobody – or not enough people – holds the office. No pressure, just the information. Tap to see duties, effort and contact person.
offices.allOfficesHint: Who does what – with duties, effort and contact person.
offices.seatsLabel: How many people hold this office?
offices.seatsHint: An office is vacant as soon as fewer people hold it than it has seats. “Ad interim” does not count as filled.
offices.whyHint: One sentence on what would be missing without this office.
offices.dutiesHint: One paragraph per duty: the first line is the heading, the lines below describe it. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
offices.pointsHint: As it applies in the club – as text, not as a calculation.
offices.holdersHint: A name is enough – the person needs no account. Pick a member once they have joined; then the distribution list reaches them.
offices.factsheetHint: A PDF up to 10 MB. Members open it from the office.

factsheetError.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.

problem.seatsInvalid: An office has between 1 and 50 seats.
problem.tooManyHolders: More holders than seats – raise the number of seats.

checkin.title: One quick question
checkin.empty: Nothing yet. After the next event we will briefly ask how it went for you.
checkin.openHint: Ten seconds, voluntary, and no points.

visibilityHint.private: Nobody else reads this – not the board either.
visibilityHint.shared_trainer: Your coach sees exactly this answer. Not your history.
visibilityHint.event_organizer: The person who called the shift sees this answer.

checkin.noPoints: There are no points for this. Taking part already gave them – a rewarded mood would be a distorted mood.
checkin.trendHint: Yours alone. Nobody else sees this curve.
checkin.trendDescription: Trend of your answers, average {{average}} out of 5
checkin.teamHint: Anonymous and aggregated. You never see individual answers.
checkin.teamTooSmall: Too few answers. Below five no value is shown – not even a rough one.

done.answered: Thank you. It stays with you, as you chose.
done.skipped: Skipped. We will not ask again for this event.

checkin.givenHint: Swipe left to show a still-private answer to your coach. This cannot be undone.
checkin.shared: Shared. Your coach sees exactly this answer.

contribution.title: Your contribution profile
contribution.saved: Saved. Suggestions follow it from now on.
contribution.strengthsTitle: What would be a meaningful contribution for you?
contribution.strengthsHint: This question comes first because it is the more important one: the club asks about you, not about its gap.
contribution.interestsTitle: What do you like to contribute to?
contribution.interestsHint: The same areas a task takes its category from – otherwise there is nothing to match.
contribution.budgetTitle: How much time do you have?

budgetHint.once: One contribution, then quiet – until you set the profile again.
budgetHint.monthly: The suggestion comes at most once a month.
budgetHint.seasonal: Several contributions, spread over the season.

contribution.budgetHintNone: Without a time budget there are no personal suggestions – but no disadvantage either.
contribution.voluntary: All voluntary. Without a profile the app stays fully usable, and nobody learns who has none.
contribution.forYouHint: Offered, not advertised – picked from what you told us.
contribution.noMatchHint: We will come to you as soon as something does. You need not search.
contribution.budgetSpent: For this period you have done enough.
contribution.budgetSpentHint: Personal suggestions are on hold. The open list below of course stays open to you.
contribution.invite: What do you like to contribute to?
contribution.inviteHint: Three questions, then the suggestions come to you.

problem.budgetMissing: Choose your time budget – otherwise it cannot be respected.
problem.nothingChosen: Choose at least one area or write a sentence.

sample.sectionHint: It disappears by itself: with the first content of the same kind you create, or after 30 days. You never have to tidy it up one by one.
sample.dropConfirm: Only content marked as an example is removed. What you created or adopted yourselves stays.
sample.dropped_one: {{count}} example removed. No club data was affected.
sample.dropped_other: {{count}} examples removed. No club data was affected.
sample.adopted: Adopted. The content now belongs to the club and acts like any other.
sample.blocked: This is an example. It shows what it looks like – you cannot take part here.

invoice.title: My invoices
invoice.listHint: Amount, due date and state. The details sit with the invoicing service – tap a row.
invoice.empty: No invoices. As soon as the club issues one, it appears here.
invoice.onTime: Paid on time – the points are credited.

billing.title: Invoicing
billing.setupDoneHint: The creditor details are complete. Invoices can go out.
billing.setupNeededHint: Without complete creditor details no invoice can be sent.
billing.creditorHint: These details appear on every payment slip. Your bank provides the QR-IBAN – it starts with CH and carries a 3 in fifth position.

problem.ibanInvalid: This IBAN is not correct – check the digits.
problem.ibanNotQr: That is an ordinary IBAN. Invoices need a QR-IBAN from your bank.
problem.name: The club name is missing.

billing.feeItemsHint: A fee with a team applies to that team's members, one without a team to everyone. A deduction is a negative amount.
billing.feeActiveHint: Switched off the fee stays on file but no longer appears in any run.
billing.periodsHint: A period is one invoice run: one purpose, one due date.
billing.prefixHint: The first digits of every payment reference in this period – digits only, ten at most. That is how you recognise them on the bank statement.
billing.pickMembersHint: Who gets an invoice. The amount accounts for the person's teams.
billing.noFeeForMember: No fee – will be left out
billing.sendConfirm: {{count}} invoices will be created as PDFs and sent by e-mail. After that they cannot be changed.
billing.invoicesHint: Swipe left to discard, cancel or open the PDF.
billing.noInvoices: No invoice in this period yet.
billing.discardConfirm: The draft will be deleted. Its payment reference is not reused.
billing.cancelConfirm: The invoice will be cancelled and the member is told. A correction is a new invoice.
billing.remindTooSoon: A reminder already went out this week.
billing.paymentsHint: Your bank's camt file. It is read on the server and matched by the payment reference.
billing.importPreviewHint: Nothing is booked yet. Only «Book» marks the invoices as paid.
billing.importUnreadable: This file cannot be read as camt.

noteAnswer.title: Note
noteAnswer.statusHint: One tap is enough. «In progress» tells the author that someone is looking.
noteAnswer.answerHint: No final status without an answer – a refusal needs its reason too.
noteAnswer.followHint: A note yields at most one task.
noteAnswer.taskHint: The transcript becomes the description. You add the why and the points.
noteAnswer.taskExists: A task has already come out of this note.
noteAnswer.followHintAdmin: A note yields at most one task. «Publish as news» makes your answer visible to the whole club.

news.readOnWebsite: Read the full article on the website

eventEdit.title: Edit event
eventEdit.scopeHint: For the whole series only future events change. Past ones stay as they happened.
eventEdit.cancelHint: The reason reaches everyone affected. A cancellation cannot be taken back.
eventEdit.cancelConfirm: Everyone affected receives the cancellation and its reason. This cannot be undone.
eventEdit.deleteConfirm: “{{title}}” will be deleted for good, including replies and shifts. An event with booked points stays – then only cancelling is possible.
eventEdit.cancelled: Cancelled. Everyone affected has been notified.

federation.title: Connect federation
federation.intro: Fixtures and results come from the federation. All it takes is your club’s id with them – nothing more.
federation.chooseHint: Supported are the federations whose interface is publicly documented.
federation.clubIdHint: It appears in the address of your club page at the federation, usually as a number.
federation.apiKeyHint: Only needed where the federation demands one. It is stored encrypted and never handed to a device.
federation.connected: Connected. The first sync is running.
federation.errorHint: The app stays fully usable – only the federation data ages.
federation.disconnectConfirm: The key is deleted and the sync ends. Events already imported stay.
federation.nextStep: Link your teams to the federation’s teams – only then do games appear.

problem.clubIdMissing: Without a club id there is nothing to sync.

federation.serviceMissing: The sync service is not answering. The connection is saved and will be checked on the next run.

legacy.title: Previous myclub app
legacy.intro: Until the club has fully moved here, both apps run side by side. Whatever you maintain in the previous app – members, teams, trainings, events, helper events with shifts and the replies to them – appears here automatically, with no double entry.
legacy.nightly: What is current in the previous app is taken over. Every night, whatever is new or changed there is added. Matches come from the federation; the replies to them come from here.
legacy.membersHint: Members from the previous app are listed here without an account. Whoever joins with the same e-mail address takes over their entry, including team and replies.
legacy.clubId: Club ID in the previous app
legacy.clubIdHint: It is part of your club page address there, for example “su-452800”. Pasting the whole address is fine.
legacy.foundCounts: {{events}} events · {{helpers}} helper events with {{shifts}} shifts · {{trainings}} trainings · {{games}} matches – as of today
legacy.connectedLater: Connected. The takeover did not go through; the nightly run will catch up.
legacy.errorHint: The app stays fully usable – only the events from the previous app go stale.
legacy.disconnectConfirm: The takeover ends. Events, members and replies already taken over remain.
legacy.disconnected: Disconnected. The events taken over remain.
legacy.empty: The previous app is not connected yet.

problem.clubIdInvalid: The ID consists of letters, digits and hyphens, for example “su-452800”.

legacy.serviceMissing: The takeover service is not responding. Please try again later.

teams.title: Teams
teams.empty: No team yet. A team is a name – the rest follows.
teams.noAreaHint: A section assigns teams to a section head. Set it on the team.
teams.areaHint: The section is one word, like “Juniors” or “Seniors”. Teams in the same section share a section head.
teams.membersHint: Swipe left removes from the team – not from the club. Assigning happens on the member.
teams.deleteConfirm: “{{name}}” will be deleted. A team with events, tasks or news stays – you will be told what still hangs on it.
teams.createHint: Section and members are added on the team afterwards.

problem.nameMissing: A team name needs at least two characters.
problem.additionTooLong: The addition is too long (40 characters at most)

teams.federationNone: No federation connected. Connect the federation first, then the team can be linked to its federation team.
teams.nameAdditionHint: The federation maintains the base name “{{name}}”, the addition is yours. Shown as: {{full}}
teams.neverSynced: Not synced yet – the games arrive with the next run.
teams.stale: The federation no longer lists this team, e.g. after a season change. Link it again or remove the link.
teams.unlinkConfirm: The team keeps its name, imported events stay. Only no new games will be fetched.
teams.linkedGames_one: Linked with “{{name}}” – {{count}} game in the agenda
teams.linkedGames_other: Linked with “{{name}}” – {{count}} games in the agenda
teams.linkedPending: Linked with “{{name}}”. The games arrive with the next sync: {{reason}}
teams.remoteFailedHint: Save the team without a link and add it later.
teams.remoteEmpty: The federation lists no teams for your club.
teams.import: Take over teams from the federation
teams.importHint: Choose which teams to take over. Teams with the same name are matched, the others are created.
teams.importedGames_one: {{created}} created, {{linked}} linked – {{count}} game in the agenda
teams.importedGames_other: {{created}} created, {{linked}} linked – {{count}} games in the agenda
teams.importedPending: {{created}} created, {{linked}} linked. The games arrive with the next sync: {{reason}}

seasonGoal.title: Contributions this season
seasonGoal.listHint: Tap a row to set an individual goal. Only the board sees this list.
seasonGoal.noGoal: You have not set a season goal yet. Until then the list only shows what has been done.
seasonGoal.goalHint: Leave empty so the club goal applies.
seasonGoal.goalExempt: Zero means this person is exempt from the season goal.
seasonGoal.goalInvalid: The goal must be zero or more.

my.title: Your season goal
my.reached: Your contribution for this season is complete.
my.openHint: These contributions suit you and count towards the goal.
my.reachedHint: Thank you. Further contributions still count, but nothing more is asked.

memberExport.title: Export members
memberExport.fieldsHint: Name, role, status and joining date are always included. You choose the rest here.
memberExport.trainerHint: Address and date of birth stay with the board. Email and phone are only included where the member made them visible.
memberExport.footnote: The list goes out the way the filter shows it.
memberExport.copied: The list is on the clipboard.

media.tooLarge: The image is too large. Pick a smaller one.
media.avatarHint: Your picture appears in lists and leaderboards of this club. It is scaled down before upload.
media.teamPhotoHint: The team photo belongs to the team. Everyone who plans for it can change it.
media.removeHint: Without an image the initials show.
media.unsupported: This image format cannot be used here. Pick a JPEG or PNG.
